input.partition_rule: every vertex belongs to M-only, N-only, or overlap; each side has at least one exclusive vertex; edges between M-only and N-only vertices are invalid
input.overlap_rule: shared terminal and shared-to-shared directed capacities are split equally between subproblems

output.meaning: packed scaled dual lower bound and overlap-consensus flag
output.encoding: 2*(dual_numerator_scaled+7000)+agreement; denominator is lcm(2,1,...,T); low bit is 1 only when overlap labels agree

agreement_flag.0: decoded value is a dual lower bound only
agreement_flag.1: decoded value is the exact global min-cut / max-flow value

algorithm_profile.method: Two-way overlap-label Lagrangian dual decomposition for an exact graph cut, following the paper's Section 3 supergradient method.
algorithm_profile.subproblems: M and N each contain both terminals, their exclusive vertices, and all overlap vertices; edges between exclusive sides are forbidden.
algorithm_profile.overlap_energy: Every original capacity incident only to overlap vertices, including terminal arcs at an overlap vertex, appears in both subproblems at half capacity.
algorithm_profile.multipliers: One signed integer fixed-point multiplier per overlap vertex, initialized to zero; M adds lambda*x and N adds -lambda*y for sink-side label bits x,y.
algorithm_profile.step_schedule: At 1-based round k, update lambda by (x-y)/k after solving both subproblems unless the overlap agrees or this is the final requested round.
algorithm_profile.exact_arithmetic: Use scale D=lcm(2,1,...,T), scale all base capacities by D, and store D*lambda; T=1 uses D=2 so shared half-costs remain integral; all divisions D/k are exact.
algorithm_profile.tie_rule: Each subproblem chooses its maximal sink-side minimum cut: label 1 wherever possible, matching the paper's stated tie convention.
algorithm_profile.termination: Run at most T subproblem evaluations and stop early only when every overlap label agrees.
algorithm_profile.interpretation: Agreement certifies a global optimum by strong duality. A finite-round disagreement reports only the dual lower bound; it is never labeled an exact cut.
algorithm_profile.packing_bound: At most seven updates occur, so each scaled multiplier has absolute value at most 840*H_7=2178 and the three overlap multipliers give g_scaled>=-6534; base subproblem energies are nonnegative. The 7000 offset therefore keeps the packed scalar nonnegative. The all-sink feasible labeling cancels dual terms and costs at most sum(source_caps)<=36, so weak duality gives g_scaled<=36*840=30240; packed result<=2*(30240+7000)+1=74481.
